description: Ring modulator that works on the bits of its two inputs: each is turned into a 16-bit number, and the two are combined with exclusive-or, with and, and with an ordinary multiplication

params.text: Sets the pitch of the internal oscillator that stands in for the Y input, from a two-hundred-and-fifty-sixth of a hertz to 4096Hz, reading out in Hz
Morphs the Y signal in the multiplying output from its full swing to its positive half only, turning a ring modulation into an amplitude modulation

inputs.text: One of the two signals combined, ±5V across the whole 16-bit range
The other of the two signals combined, ±5V across the whole 16-bit range; with nothing patched an internal sine oscillator takes its place
Pitch input tracking one volt per octave, added to the pitch set by the frequency knob, and it moves the internal oscillator only
Shifts the ring modulation towards amplitude modulation, 5V covering the whole of that knob's travel, with the total held inside it

outputs.text: The exclusive-or of the two signals, softly clipped, ±5V
The and of the two signals, ±5V
The two signals multiplied, softly clipped, ±5V

notes: the frequency knob and the pitch input do nothing while something is patched into the Y input; they set the internal oscillator that stands in for it.

inputs.0:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads an internal sine oscillator.
inputs.2:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.3:
continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
